experiment_data.hypothesis: TCN σ=1.0 on Cheetah tests whether higher noise amplitude further suppresses CIVO. σ=0.5 (exp_030b) was negative with NVE peaking at 10.67@55K then declining. σ=1.0 should provide stronger temporal regularization. If NVE stays below 1.5 throughout training and eval_return ≥ baseline → TCN generalizes to Cheetah with appropriate σ scaling.
